text:
Priya (SRE): Postmortem for the 2026-03-20 serving disruption is published: https://redwood.in/rca/176777. Short summary: routing overload triggered fallback misconfig + KV-cache eviction cascades. Root cause, timeline, and mitigations are in the doc. Please review and ack.

Priya (SRE): Action items extracted from the RCA (owners + rough ETAs):
1) Fix fallback routing bug (race with capacity routing) — owner: Jordan (Eng Runtime) — ETA: 2026-04-03
2) Add synthetic KV-cache eviction test to nightly suite — owner: Alex (Product) — ETA: 2026-04-10
3) Revise runbook + pager thresholds and add canary step before automatic fallback — owner: Jordan (Eng Runtime) — ETA: 2026-03-30
4) Draft customer-facing comms and account notes — owner: Sam (Support) — ETA: 2026-03-25
5) Post-deploy monitoring dashboard (latency + routing errors) — owner: Marta (Eng-SRE) — ETA: 2026-04-07

Jordan (Eng Runtime): Ack. I'll take #1 and #3. Will open a PR for the routing fix by Fri and add a feature-flagged canary plan.
Alex (Product): I'll pair with Research on #2. Will sketch the synthetic test cases by next Tue.
Sam (Support): I'll draft the account comms and share a one-pager in #customer-success and here.
Marta (Eng-SRE): Quick Q — do we want the canary to be time-based or traffic-split? I prefer 5% traffic split for 1 hour.
Jordan (Eng Runtime): Agree on traffic-split. I'll implement the control plane flag and the canary script.
Priya (SRE): Updated: Jordan now owns #3 as well. First checkpoint sync scheduled: 2026-03-27 10:00 PT (15m) to review PRs, canary plan, and comms draft. Please RSVP or add blockers here.
Alex (Product): Added calendar invite.
ops-bot: Postmortem doc saved: https://redwood.in/rca/176777 (permissions: team-readable).
Sam (Support): Will add a short FAQ for account teams and tag relevant AMs by EOD Thu.
Priya (SRE): Thanks everyone. If there are no blockers, we'll mark the RCA follow-ups ongoing and plan to close the loop by 2026-04-10. Add any comments inline in the doc or ping me. :white_check_mark:
